excerpts: Basically, the basic cost for the PCB consists of the engineering fee and the board fee. For a single PCB that is within or equal to 102*102mm, there is a special price charged only.

15. Large Board Fee If the board is too large, the labor and materials used will increase significantly. When the area of one board exceeds 650 square centimeters, an additional charge will be added every 50 square centimeters.

If the trace width or spacing of multi-layer boards is 3.0-3.5mil, extra cost will be charged for the difficulty of the process: 20% of the order amount for 4-8 layers, and 30% of the order amount for 10 layers and above.
If the length of the board reaches or exceeds 60cm, the extra charge will be $31.43 per design for the prototype and $31.43 per square meter for the batch order.
